notes.title: Update Notes for June 8
notes.content:
1：The village chief and the doctor no longer wander around at night being chased by monsters, making them easier to find.

2：Arrow towers can now predict enemy positions, making their attacks more effective.

3：A new building, the "Signpost", has been added. It can point toward home, so you won’t get lost in the wilderness.

4：Some dialogue text has been revised.

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
1：Added a timeline system – You can now see the current time of day and night, making it easier to plan your work.

2：Improved companion NPC behavior – Adjusted logic to reduce the chances of teammates getting knocked down in the wilderness and becoming hard to find.

3：Slightly reduced enemy numbers in the first two days.

4：Decreased the amount of wood needed to add arrows to arrow towers – now more cost-effective.

5：Fixed some rare bugs.ːsteamhappyː
